name: Applied Digital Corporation
summary:
Applied Digital (APLD) reported a loss of $0.01 per share on revenue of $341.88 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.25 per share on revenue of $134.10 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $0.31 per share. The company beat expectations by 96.77% while revenue grew 432.38% on a year-over-year basis.

“Our goal is to establish Applied Digital as the category leader in the design, construction, deployment, and operation of purpose-built AI factories,” said Wes Cummins, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Applied Digital. “We are building for the long term, with a clear focus on developing large-scale, sustainable AI factory campuses and securing durable, high-quality, long-term contracts with proven, tier-one, investment grade hyperscalers that are leaders in the AI industry.”

Applied Digital designs, develops and operates next-generation data centers across North America to provide digital infrastructure solutions to the rapidly growing high-performance computing (HPC) industry.
subject: Applied Digital Beat Expectations

name: Richardson Electronics, Ltd.
summary:
Richardson Electronics, (RELL) reported earnings of $0.27 per share on revenue of $64.92 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.09 per share on revenue of $58.99 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 200.00% while revenue grew 18.89% on a year-over-year basis.

Richardson Electronics, Ltd. is a leading global provider of engineered solutions, power grid and microwave tubes and related consumables; power conversion and RF and microwave components; high value flat panel detector solutions, replacement parts, tubes and service training for diagnostic imaging equipment; and customized display solutions.
subject: Richardson Electronics, Beat Consensus Estimates

name: Levi Strauss & Co.
summary:
Levi Strauss (LEVI) reported earnings of $0.48 per share on revenue of $1.61 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.36 per share on revenue of $1.61 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.39 per share. The company beat expectations by 23.08% while revenue grew 4.30% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects fiscal 2026 non-GAAP earnings of $1.54 to $1.56 per share on revenue of approximately $6.722 billion. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $1.46 to $1.52 per share on revenue of $6.722 billion to $6.753 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.54 per share on revenue of $6.760 billion for the year ending November 30, 2026.

Levi Strauss & Co. (LS&Co.) is one of the world’s largest brand-name apparel companies and a global leader in jeanswear. The company designs and markets jeans, casual wear and related accessories for men, women and children under the Levi’s®, Dockers®, Signature by Levi Strauss & Co.TM, and Denizen® brands.
subject: Levi Strauss Beat Expectations, Revises Guidance

name: Resources Connection, Inc.
summary:
Resources Connection, Inc. (RGP) reported a loss of $0.16 per share on revenue of $98.09 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.18 per share on revenue of $99.52 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $0.16 per share. The company reported in-line with expectations while revenue fell 18.42% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said during its conference call it expects second quarter revenue of $95.0 million to $100.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $108.60 million for the quarter ending November 30, 2026.

RGP has been redefining professional services for 30 years by closing the gap between advice and execution.
subject: Resources Connection, Inc. Reported In-line with Expectations, Sees Revenue Below Estimates
